title: Self-Aware AI Review Bias Detection: Enabling Real-Time Bias Identification in AI-Generated Scientific Reviews

contributions.purpose: 为 AI 生成审稿建立实时偏见自检框架
contributions.mechanism: 三阶段流程:生成初稿→用五类偏见(位置/长度/负面/自我强化/领域熟悉)的词典模式匹配打 bias_score→超阈值时提示模型自我修正
contributions.evaluation: 五类偏见在基线审稿中检出率 23%-71%(长度偏见 71% 最高)
contributions.domain: AI 辅助同行评审 / LLM 偏见检测
contributions.source_quote: We develop the first comprehensive framework for real-time bias detection in AI-generated scientific reviews, targeting five critical bias types identified through systematic analysis of AI review patterns.

contributions.purpose: 跨模型验证自检框架的有效性
contributions.mechanism: 在 GPT-4o/Claude-Sonnet-4/Llama-3.1-8B/Mistral-7B 上各 6 篇论文做基线 vs 自检对照,Bonferroni 校正(α=0.0063)+Cohen's d
contributions.source_quote: We conduct rigorous experimental validation across four state-of-the-art language models using controlled comparisons on scientific papers, employing statistical validation with Bonferroni correction to ensure robust findings.

contributions.purpose: 揭示自检能力高度依赖模型架构
contributions.mechanism: 对比四模型的偏见降低/置信改善/自检准确率三指标
contributions.evaluation: Mistral-7B 偏见降低为负(-45.2%,p=0.0001,d=-4.52),自我修正反而放大偏见;自检准确率与降偏效果不同步(Mistral 自检 83.3% 但修正失败)
contributions.source_quote: Mistral-7B showed concerning negative bias reduction (-45.2%), indicating that self-correction attempts introduce additional biases.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Constitutional AI approaches enable models to critique and improve their own outputs [1], while self-refinement methods allow iterative improvement of generated content [5]. However, these approaches have not been specifically applied to bias detection and correction in scientific review contexts.

Our work bridges these research areas by developing specialized self-awareness mechanisms for scientific review bias detection, contributing to both the AI bias detection literature and the emerging field of AI-assisted peer review.

notes: 贡献列表明确(threefold)。负结果:Mistral-7B 自我修正使偏见恶化 -45.2%(p=0.0001,d=-4.52),Llama-3.1-8B 降偏不显著(p=0.059)。内部矛盾严重:checklist Limitations 自述'single AI model evaluation (GPT-4 only)'和'27 arXiv papers',与正文四模型×6 篇矛盾;checklist 又自述'Low self-detection accuracy (7.0%)'与正文 83.3% 矛盾,疑为模板残留/虚构。偏见检测仅词典模式匹配,无人工验证(自认第四条局限)。AI 披露:hypothesis/实验/分析/写作四项全 AI-generated。
